title: fix(spec,lint): os lint reports an omitted cbp master required on the default defineStack door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CZHtkC74Ydb9at95QTnivt)_
Fixes #33940
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：默认（strict）`defineStack` 解析时，如果作者在 `controlled_by_parent` 对象的 `master_detail` 上没写 `required`，spec 会在解析后的字段上悄悄记一笔“作者省略了”；`os lint` 的 `relationship/master-detail-required` 读这笔记录，在默认写法下也报 error。
- 为什么改：裁决 A（#30905，记录 6687830530）放行可选主字段，同时承诺 `os lint` 对省略写法报错；但默认 strict 解析先把省略填成 false，lint 永远看不到，迁移说明那句话在最常见的写法下是假的。
- 风险与回滚：解析结果不变（仍是 `required: false`，可选主字段），栈照常加载，`os validate` / `os build` 不变；只是 `os lint` 在这一种写法上多报一条 error。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/master-detail-required-omission.ts`（记录与读取），`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 中 `recordMasterDetailRequiredOmissions` 的调用，`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` 中 `optionalMaster` 那一行。
- 两分钟验证：在示例应用副本的默认 `defineStack({ … })` 里加一个 cbp 对象，唯一的 master_detail 不写 required，跑 `os lint --json`：应 exit 1，报 relationship/master-detail-required 在 `.required`；改成 `required: false` 后应 exit 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`** — new module `src/data/master-detail-required-omission.ts`. After a strict `defineStack` parse succeeds, `recordMasterDetailRequiredOmissions(normalized.objects, data.objects)` stamps a non-enumerable, non-writable `Symbol.for('objectstack.field.masterDetailRequiredOmitted')` on each parsed `master_detail` field of a `controlled_by_parent` object whose authored definition writes no `required`. The one published reader is `masterDetailRequiredOmitted(field)` (`@objectstack/spec/data`); the stamp is internal (not re-exported), mirroring `stack-provenance.ts`. The parsed value is untouched (`required: false`), so the ruled reading (option A: the omission is admitted as the optional master) holds at every runtime reader, and nothing refuses the stack.
- **`@objectstack/lint`** — `cbpMasterReferenceFinding` (R2) treats a sole `master_detail` as the optional master only when `required === false` AND the field does not carry the record. On the default door the omitted spelling now gets the same finding, path and fix it already got on `{ strict: false }` and on a raw config.
- **Why on the field, not the stack:** `loadConfig` (`packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts`) spreads the default export into a new object, which drops a stack-level symbol (that is why it reads `stackConversionsOf` before the spread). The `objects` array and each field reach `lintDataModel` by reference, so a field-level record needs no `packages/cli` change and no second load of the user's module. Measured: `composeStacks` (error / override / merge) keeps the record on the composed field too.
- Regenerated: `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json` (one added export each).
- **Fix of text this change made false:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`, item `cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts`. Revision 4 (PR #33929, merged into main while this card was in flight) moved the item's `os lint` arm to `{ strict: false }` and said the default strict door gives `os lint` exit 0 with no finding. That is no longer true, so revision 5 moves steps[2] and acceptance[3] back to the default door, states that the default door reports only `relationship/master-detail-required` (not `security-controlled-by-parent-no-relation`, because the parsed field is the optional master the runtime derives access from) and keeps `{ strict: false }` as the second door. No other clause changed.
- Docblocks touched: `data-model-rules.ts` (R2 header), `controlled-by-parent-master.ts` (module header). The semantic entry `cbp-optional-master-admitted` is unchanged: its sentence "`os lint` reports the omission at `error`" is now true on the default door, which was the seat's call (fix the reach, not the prose).

## Why

The maintainer ruling on #30905 (record 6687830530), option 「A 放行为可选主字段(推荐)」, keeps the omitted `required` readable as the optional master at the parse and pairs it with the lint: "`os lint` errors on the omitted spelling". The published entry repeats that promise. On the ordinary authoring door it did not hold (measured on #33842 / PR #33929).

## Tests

New, no existing assertion edited (no forced test edits):

- `packages/spec/src/data/master-detail-required-omission.test.ts` (7 cases): strict `defineStack` records an omitted `required` on the sole master and on a second `master_detail` beside a required one; nothing for explicit `false` / `true`, for another sharing model, for a lookup, for `{ strict: false }`, or for a bare `ObjectSchema.safeParse`; the record is invisible to `Object.keys`, `JSON.stringify` and `FieldSchema`, and a copy drops it.
- `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.master-detail-required.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` (4 cases) over stacks a real `defineStack` built: omitted → one error at `.required` with both spellings; CONTROLS explicit `false` and `true` → clean; `{ strict: false }` → the same finding as before; a copied field → clean (the pre-record reading).

Ablations (each committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` hit, then restored with blob == HEAD and rebuilt with the marker absent from dist):

- A1, lint stops reading the record: lint unit `the sole master_detail without required` turns red (1 failed / 33 passed); the CLI on the default door reads `os lint` exit 0, passed true, 0 R2 findings (the defect).
- A2, `defineStack` stops stamping: spec unit 3 failed / 4 passed (src), lint unit 1 failed / 33 passed (spec dist), CLI default door `os lint` exit 0 with 0 R2 findings.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: yes` differs from the claim's expected `no`: the diff adds one public export, `masterDetailRequiredOmitted` on `@objectstack/spec/data`, and the spec lane charter counts any widening of the public surface as Clause ②. No parse accept set moves, so `Metadata-protocol: none` and patch changesets.
- On the default door only R2 fires; `security-controlled-by-parent-no-relation` does not, because the stack the runtime loads really does derive the optional master from the parsed `false`. On `{ strict: false }` both fire, as before.
- Not reached by design: the save door and a bare `ObjectSchema.safeParse` record nothing (neither runs `os lint`); `ObjectSchema.create()` still forces an omitted `required` to `true`.
- The record lives in `packages/spec` as a declared producer record beside the provenance mark, not as business logic: it states what the author wrote and nothing reads it at runtime.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exits 1 at Node's default heap in this container: its `check:test-typecheck` leg's `tsc` dies without diagnostics. At `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144` (the heap `lint.yml` sets for the ledger re-measure) it exits 0 with all 14 artifacts current, and `check:test-typecheck` alone reads OK (52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures held).

## Verification

Verification head: `d468bb80`, a merge-only commit (main `e71ecc1b` merged in via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`) made under the seat's K ≥ 15 landing rule. The PR's diff is byte-identical to the one verified at `6e1439cc`: `git diff b4ce310b 6e1439cc` and `git diff e71ecc1b d468bb80` hash to the same sha256 (`aa771be5…`). The readings below were verified at `6e1439cc` (main `b4ce310b` merged in via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`; no conflict, the regen chain found nothing to rewrite). Re-read at `6e1439cc` after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `rm -rf packages/runtime/.objectstack` and a full `./packages/**` rebuild under the verify lock: `check:generated` exit 0 (all 14 artifacts current), spec test 843 files / 26968 tests passed, lint test 212 files / 9030 tests passed, the four end-to-end readings below unchanged, and the 96 derived gates all exit 0 at heap 6144 (`--ran`: 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). CI on `6e1439cc`: every check-run completed, all required contexts success. The readings below were first taken at `eb7616fe` (main `0ac112fc` merged in), with the same results.

<details>
<summary>End to end: the #33929 reproduction and its controls (scratch copy of examples/app-todo, CLI from the tree)</summary>

```
=== sole master_detail, required omitted, default strict defineStack
os lint --json exit 1   passed false
   error relationship/master-detail-required at objects[2].fields.hdr.required
os validate --json exit 0
os build exit 0
=== required: false, default door
os lint --json exit 0   passed true
os validate --json exit 0
os build exit 0
=== required: true, default door
os lint --json exit 0   passed true
os validate --json exit 0
os build exit 0
=== required omitted, defineStack(..., { strict: false })
os lint --json exit 1   passed false
   error relationship/master-detail-required at objects[2].fields.hdr.required
   error security-controlled-by-parent-no-relation at objects[2].sharingModel
os validate --json exit 0
os build exit 0
```

Base reading (#33929, at 895783a1): the first case gave `os lint --json` exit 0 with no finding. The shipped examples app-crm and app-todo lint with no R2 finding (their cbp masters are built by `ObjectSchema.create()`, which writes `required: true`); app-showcase's config could not load here (its connector-slack dist is not in the CLI closure), and its two cbp masters are `ObjectSchema.create()` with `required: true` in source.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Package tests and typecheck (under the verify lock)</summary>

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test        Test Files 843 passed (843)   Tests 26968 passed | 1 todo
pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test        Test Files 212 passed (212)   Tests 9030 passed
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck   VERDICT command-exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck   VERDICT command-exit 0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit   Test Files 422 passed (422)   Tests 6002 passed
```

The cli integration layer is declared to CI (no spawn entry or integration file touched).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands at eb7616fe, re-run at 6e1439cc)</summary>

96 derived families, 96 run, reconciled with `--ran`: "96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". 95 exited 0 at the default heap; `check:generated` exited 1 there (the out-of-memory `tsc` above) and 0 at the CI heap of 6144, which is the line reconciled. `check:platform-checklist` exit 0 (16 areas, 429 items). `check:dev-prereqs` (local-only family): NOT MEASURED, 34 `ui/` packages unbuilt in this container.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic (the record is a producer stamp beside the provenance mark; nothing reads it at runtime).
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
